content.title: 2026 KENTUCKY DERBY - FINAL TOP 10 - Presented by DK Horse
content.text: Peter Thomas Fornatale (PTF) and Jonathon Kinchen (JK) reveal the final Kentucky Derby Top 10 as compiled by Eric DeCoster, with the 2026 Derby picture now sharpening after major prep race wins in the Arkansas Derby, Florida Derby, Blue Grass Stakes, Louisiana Derby, Jeff Ruby Steaks, Virginia Derby, and Fukuryu Stakes. This episode centers on the final Kentucky Derby Top 10 list without revealing the order here, while spotlighting the horses who have done the most to earn attention on the Road to the Kentucky Derby. The final Top 10 includes Renegade, Commandment, The Puma, Further Ado, Chief Wallabee, Incredibolt, Silent Tactic, Emerging Market, Danon Bourbon, and Fulleffort. Renegade comes in off a Grade 1 Arkansas Derby victory at Oaklawn Park and closed as the favorite in Future Pool 6, while Commandment stamped his class with a Grade 1 Florida Derby win at Gulfstream Park. The Puma was right there in the Florida Derby as well, finishing second after another battle-tested performance, and Further Ado forced his way into the conversation with a huge Grade 1 Blue Grass Stakes win at Keeneland. Chief Wallabee continued to build his résumé with strong efforts in both the Fountain of Youth and Florida Derby for Bill Mott, while Incredibolt added a Virginia Derby win for Riley Mott after already showing quality at Churchill Downs. Silent Tactic brings consistency to the table for Mark Casse, having finished first or second in all of his starts while competing in races like the Southwest, Rebel, and Arkansas Derby. Emerging Market adds intrigue after winning the Louisiana Derby in just his second lifetime start for Chad Brown, and Danon Bourbon gives the list an international angle after his Fukuryu Stakes win at Nakayama. Fulleffort also enters the final Kentucky Derby conversation after taking the Grade 3 Jeff Ruby Steaks and trying to answer the dirt question on the first Saturday in May. This final Kentucky Derby Top 10 also sits within a much wider Derby landscape that has included names such as Potente, So Happy, Albus, Pavlovian, Golden Tempo, Ottinho, Right to Party, Nearly, Iron Honor, Chip Honcho, Wonder Dean, Six Speed, and others who have helped shape the 3-year-old division. Horses like Further Ado, Renegade, Commandment, Chief Wallabee, and The Puma have been central figures in recent Kentucky Derby rankings, while others such as Incredibolt, Emerging Market, Silent Tactic, Danon Bourbon, and Fulleffort continue to add depth and intrigue to the 2026 Kentucky Derby field. With the Kentucky Derby set for Churchill Downs, this video is built for horse racing fans following Derby contenders, Kentucky Derby prep races, speed figures, pedigree angles, future odds, and the final shape of the Derby trail. Whether you are tracking Renegade, Commandment, The Puma, Further Ado, Chief Wallabee, Incredibolt, Silent Tactic, Emerging Market, Danon Bourbon, or Fulleffort, this episode delivers the final Eric DeCoster Kentucky Derby Top 10 discussion as the Run for the Roses approaches.
